approved_meaning: NaN correlation diagonal entries are set to one only for the self-correlation integrity check; no covariance portfolio or return estimate is imputed.
Missing provider coverage ratios are deterministically recomputed as observed returns divided by the available sample length; the fallback is bounded to the same historical window.
Missing market-cap evidence receives a neutral percentile of 0.5 as an explicit policy assumption and never supports an exact market-cap top-100 claim.
A ticker without mapped market-cap evidence receives the same neutral 0.5 liquidity proxy and remains subject to source and market-cap limitations.
An undefined selection ratio caused by missing or zero volatility is assigned negative infinity so the asset is rejected from ranking rather than rewarded or treated as an observed return.
